jamie (release-ops): Quick FYI: were moving the cache-shard cutover up to Tue 23:00-02:00 UTC due to upstream maintenance. Short soft freeze for the release train 22:30-02:30 UTC. Please scan the checklist and ack if you own a lane. :rotating_light:

omar (eng-runtime): Acked. We'll freeze runtime image promotions and lock model-variant tagging.

li (eng-platform): Platform will throttle automated infra changes 21:30-03:30 UTC. Any urgent infra must go through exception form.

tara (eng-sre): Oncall: running -4h smoke and -30m full preflight. Will bump trace retention +48h and enable extra debug sampling for the window.

maya (product): Product asks PMs to pause all ramping feature flags and hold new experiments. We'll only flip flags manually for critical fixes.

jamie (release-ops): Canary flow: 4 waves (1%, 5%, 30%, 100%) with health gates. Gate checks: errors, p99 latency, OOMs. Auto-pause on gate fail. Rollback threshold: >5 errors/min OR p99 >3x baseline for 3 minutes.

oncall-bot: SCHEDULED: cache-shard-cutover-2201 at 23:15 UTC (jamie).

omar (eng-runtime): Note: websocket sessions may see 503s for ~20s. We'll enable stale-read fallback for 90s and surface metrics to canary dashboards.

li (eng-platform): Preflight commands if you want to validate groups:
```
rgctl get targets --env prod --group cache-cutover-2201
rgctl health --group cache-cutover-2201 --output json\```

tara (eng-sre): Condensed preflight checklist:
- smoke tests green on canary
- perf quick-run p50/p95/p99 vs baseline
- alerting runbook linked in channel
- rollback shard snapshot present

jamie (release-ops): Runbook + exception: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cache-cutover-2201 and https://redwood.internal/forms/release-exception. Exceptions need owner, rollback steps, approver.

maya (product): Customer comms: we'll delay public banner until +60m after final canary and call it out on status page.

omar (eng-runtime): If you have an emergency hotfix, DM me and cc jamie. We'll coordinate fast-track approvals.

li (eng-platform): Small request: avoid schema/keyname changes to caching layer for 48h pre-cutover. That caused the previous incidents.

jamie (release-ops): Final: soft freeze 22:30-02:30 UTC Tue. Canary start 23:15 UTC. Please ack here if youre owning any rollout tasks or need an exception. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
